question: Planet Pluto was discovered by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Clyde Tombaugh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pluto was discovered by Clyde Tombaugh on February 18, 1930**, at the Lowell Observatory in Flagstaff, Arizona.
 
• Tombaugh was an American astronomer who was born on February 4, 1906, and passed away on January 17, 1997.
 
• He discovered Pluto while systematically searching the sky for a ninth planet, which was then referred to as "Planet X."
 
• The discovery of Pluto was announced on March 13, 1930, which was the 75th anniversary of the discovery of Neptune and the birthday of Percival Lowell, who had predicted the existence of a ninth planet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **William Herschel:**

 
 
• He was a British astronomer who discovered **Uranus **in 1781.
 
• He also discovered infrared radiation and conducted extensive studies of nebulae and star clusters.
 
 
 
• **Johann Galle:**
 
 
• He was a German astronomer who is credited with the **first observation of Neptune **in 1846.
 
• He used calculations made by Urbain Le Verrier to locate the planet.
 
 
 
• **John Adams:**
 
 
• He was a British mathematician and astronomer who independently **calculated the position of Neptune, leading to its discovery**.
 
• His calculations were similar to those of Le Verrier and helped confirm the existence of Neptune.
